data.close_reason: Operator ruling: reversing ADR 0038/0089 rejected; environmental, not a rebar defect. Challenge failed: the only watchdog capture is a false positive (a zsh pgrep poller), no wedged process was ever stack-dumped, and pmset logs show 118 sleep events incl. multi-hour thermal/clamshell sleeps bracketing the incident window — wall-clock elapsed overstates awake time and macOS monotonic timers pause during sleep, so the per-request timeout behaving as documented is consistent with all observations. Reopen only with a real stack dump of a rebar op wedged >600s of verifiably-awake time.
